title: Notice on New Trading Pairs & Trading Bots Services on Binance Spot - 2024-03-13 & 2024-03-14
text: Fellow Binancians, 	 To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Spot and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance will open trading for the following trading pairs: At  2024-03-13 08:00 (UTC) :   FLOKI/FDUSD, GRT/FDUSD, NEAR/USDC, SNX/TRY At  2024-03-14 08:00 (UTC) :   EUR/USDC, FET/USDC, IMX/TRY In addition, Binance will enable Trading Bots services for the following trading pairs: At  2024-03-13 08:00 (UTC) :   Spot Algo Orders: FLOKI/FDUSD, GRT/FDUSD, NEAR/USDC, SNX/TRY At  2024-03-14 08:00 (UTC) : Spot Grid & Spot DCA: WIF/USDT, XRP/FDUSD Rebalancing Bot: WIF/USDT  Spot Algo Orders: EUR/USDC, FET/USDC, IMX/TRY Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes: EUR and TRY are fiat currencies and do not represent any other digital currencies. Users will enjoy zero maker fees on  FDUSD  trading pairs until further notice. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-03-12
